description:
Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

 
 Job Title :
AI Engineer, Commercial Aircraft Group 
 Reporting To: 
IT Director - Commercial Aircraft 
 Work Schedule: 
Onsite – Buffalo, NY Job Description

 Moog, Inc. is a global leader in high-performance motion control systems, designing and manufacturing advanced solutions that support aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical applications worldwide.

 Our Commercial Aircraft Group (CAG) in East Aurora, NY is currently seeking an AI Engineer to join a collaborative and innovative technology team. In this role, you will design, develop, deploy, and support Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, advanced analytics, intelligent agents, and automation solutions that accelerate business transformation across engineering, manufacturing, operations, quality, and supply chain functions. You will serve as a key technical contributor responsible for building scalable AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, streamline business processes, enable data-driven decision-making, and deliver measurable business value while partnering with stakeholders across the business and IT organizations. 

 To be considered for this AI Engineer role, here's what you'll typically need to bring with you: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
 Typically 3-7 years of combined experience in software development, solution engineering, automation development, data engineering, analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or related technical disciplines
 Experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying enterprise applications and business solutions
 Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation technologies
 Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Power Automate, and related technologies is preferred
 Proficiency in one or more development languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, SQL, or similar technologies
 Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and cloud-based platforms
 Understanding of data architecture, data modeling, data quality, and analytics principles
 Familiarity with modern web technologies and frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure including DevOps, messaging systems, and Infrastructure as Code
 Experience with Blazor (Server or WebAssembly) is preferred
 Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Semantic Memory, or similar technologies is preferred
 Practical knowledge of containerization technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and/or Azure Container Apps
 Understanding of distributed system architectures and design patterns
 Experience with REST APIs and testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or REST Client
 Experience with unit testing and integration testing
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
 Knowledge of cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, and Responsible AI concepts
 Experience working collaboratively with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams
 Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
 Experience supporting manufacturing, aerospace, engineering, supply chain, quality, or operations environments is preferred
 Experience building AI-powered copilots, intelligent agents, and conversational applications is a plus
 Experience developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, knowledge retrieval systems, and semantic search capabilities is a plus
 Familiarity with ERP, MES, PLM, quality management, and manufacturing systems is preferred
 Knowledge of MLOps, prompt engineering, AI evaluation frameworks, and model governance practices is preferred
 Experience with Agile development methodologies and product-based delivery models is preferred
 Microsoft, Azure, AI, Power Platform, or software development certifications are a plus
 
 As our AI Engineer, you will make critical contributions by holding responsibility for: 

 Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, copilots, analytics solutions, and automation capabilities
 Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify opportunities, and translate business challenges into technical solutions
 Develop scalable and reusable AI-enabled capabilities aligned with enterprise architecture standards
 Build and maintain integrations between AI solutions, enterprise systems, data sources, and business applications
 Implement prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval, and orchestration techniques to improve AI solution quality and reliability
 Design and develop Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and Generative AI solutions supporting business and operational objectives
 Create and maintain enterprise copilots, agents, and conversational experiences that improve productivity and access to information
 Develop knowledge retrieval, search, and recommendation capabilities leveraging enterprise content and data sources
 Support proof-of-concept, pilot, and production AI implementations
 Continuously evaluate and optimize AI model performance, accuracy, usability, and business value
 Develop APIs, services, connectors, workflows, and integrations supporting AI-enabled business processes
 Integrate AI capabilities into existing business applications and digital platforms
 Collaborate with architects and developers to ensure solution scalability, maintainability, and performance
 Support system testing, user acceptance testing, deployment activities, and production readiness reviews
 Resolve technical issues and support ongoing enhancement initiatives
 Collaborate with data engineers and business teams to identify, prepare, and leverage data required for AI initiatives
 Develop dashboards, reports, analytics, and data-driven insights supporting business decision-making
 Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, and capabilities for applicability within the Commercial Aircraft Group
 Identify opportunities to improve business processes through AI, automation, and advanced analytics
 Design and implement solutions that comply with enterprise cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, and Responsible AI requirements
 Partner with Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Data Management, and Corporate AI teams to ensure compliance with established standards
 Support user adoption through demonstrations, documentation, training materials, and knowledge-sharing activities
 Provide technical guidance to business users, citizen developers, and AI champions
 Develop technical documentation, solution architectures, support procedures, and implementation guides
 Serve as a trusted technical advisor for AI-related initiatives and opportunities
 Contribute to establishing AI engineering standards, development frameworks, and best practices
 Foster innovation, continuous learning, and responsible AI adoption across the Commercial Aircraft Group
 
 How we care for you: 

 Financial Rewards: Great compensation package, annual profit sharing, matching 401k, and the ability to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
 Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, holidays and parental leave program
 Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages
 Professional Skills Development: Tuition Assistance, mentorship and coaching opportunities, leadership development and other personal growth programs
 Culture: Warm, respectful, family-like environment driven by our core values. Multiple Employee Resource Groups led by our employees, open and welcoming to all.
 Additional Benefits: Site-specific benefits may also be available depending on location and business needs.
 

 #LI-TB2
 
 Salary Range Transparency: 
Buffalo, NY $100,000.00–$150,000.00 Annually
 Salary Range Disclaimer 
 The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Moog salary range for this position in the given work location. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range(s) listed is just one component of Moog's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, employee stock purchase plan, an open paid time off policy, and many region-specific benefits. 

 This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled information.

 Moog offers an inclusive workplace, and, as such, affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. If you are interested in applying for employment and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply for a posted position, contact our Human Resources department via phone at 844-367-5787. 

 No unsolicited agency submittals please. Agency partners must be invited to participate in a search by our Talent Acquisition Team and have signed terms in place prior to any submittal. Absent compliance with these pre-conditions resumes submitted directly to any Moog Inc. employee or affiliate will not qualify for fee payment, and therefore become the property of Moog Inc.
